title: Ledger Flex from CryptoBilis, shared by @sakak_musdom

purchase.store: CryptoBilis booth, Global Pizza Party, Raintree Club
purchase.dateNote: Bought in person at the CryptoBilis booth at the Global Pizza Party on 22 May 2026, at the Raintree Club in Kuala Lumpur, per the post and GitHub issue #1.

components: Nordic Semiconductor nRF9151 LTE-M / NB-IoT module (NRF9151 LACA A1, FCC ID 2ANPO00NRF9151, IC 24529-NRF9151), lot line read as 2539XAAC00LAPD2
eSIM chip to the right of the module, per the post
QFN chip and a shielded can next to the module
u.FL connector on the implant board, and a flexible antenna marked "AC-A1911-FLEX-V1.1" with a coax lead, stuck to the inside of the back cover
implant.notes: Adam Mashrique (@sakak_musdom), in Malaysia, found the implant in a friend's Ledger Flex. The friend set it up but never used it, so no funds were lost. The friend had seen @sakak_musdom's call in the Bitcoiner Malaysia Telegram groups for anyone who bought a Ledger from CryptoBilis, and reached out. The implant board sits beside the battery, next to the Flex's own flex cables, with the nRF9151 module, an eSIM chip and a u.FL connector for the antenna on the back cover. On 10 October 2026 @sakak_musdom had asked whether anyone who bought from CryptoBilis had found an implant, as the known victims then seemed to have bought from Lazada sellers. This is the third implanted device traced to CryptoBilis, after the two Stax bought online on 27 April 2026, and the first bought at one of its events.

images.caption: The Flex opened: the back cover with the "AC-A1911-FLEX-V1.1" antenna and its coax lead (top), and the body with the implant board along the right edge, beside the battery (bottom). A larger copy of the first photo in the X post.

The implant board: the nRF9151 module (FCC ID 2ANPO00NRF9151) with the eSIM chip to its right, a QFN chip and a shielded can to its left, and the u.FL connector below. A wider, larger copy of the second photo in the X post.

The back cover lifted with the Flex's own NFC coil (EU_NFC_FPC Rev 2.1.0) still in place: the antenna's coax lead runs from the cover down to the implant board, beneath the coil. The device has an orange frame.
